dbToolScopingDenylist.deck_events: Durable access-request audit rows are written by the request action and are not exposed through generic agent DB reads.
dbToolScopingDenylist.deck_share_links: Share snapshots are created by create-share-link and read through opaque share tokens; raw DB access could enumerate snapshot content.
dbToolScopingDenylist.slide_comments: Comment rows are child records of decks; comment actions check deck access and scope reads and writes by deck ID.
dbToolScopingDenylist.deck_access_request_limits: Anonymous access-request rate-limit counters are read and updated only by request-deck-access as anti-abuse state.
